title: Safety
description: Safety as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are hazards of the installation identified and recorded?
Is a Safety Classification proposed for each item?
Are safety requirements allocated to the installation?
Is a preliminary safety assessment (for example failure modes and effects) done?
Are common-cause and zonal hazards assessed?
Are safety requirements reflected in the preliminary design?
Is the safety assessment complete for the released design?
Is the Safety Classification of each Part and Assembly confirmed?
Are safety-critical items and their controls identified on the released definitions?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
